purpose: Adversarial cases for prototype C (fillet-rollingball-{tori,spline}), written by the independent verifier on 2026-09-24. Same format as cases.json; group "adversarial". Run with tmp/fillet/verify-rb/adv-run.mjs. Cases with a `regression` record are the repros of the defects fixed by fix:fillet-rollingball (2026-09-24); the adv-rb-fix-* cases pin those fixes at their limits (tmp/fillet/fix-rb/adv-cases-fix.mjs; re-run it after the verifier's generator).

conventions.size: fillet radius or equal-offset chamfer distance (Onshape EQUAL_OFFSETS; off 90° the face-offset definition, theory §5.2)
conventions.select: near: the edge within 1e-6 mm of the point; all; parallel: straight edges parallel to the axis; inPlane: edges lying in the plane; segment: edges lying on the segment
conventions.closedForm: deltaVolume = result volume - input volume (negative = material removed)
conventions.rank: edge-configuration rank in docs/fillet/corpus.md §4.1 (99 = not measured in the corpus)

existence limit: post R=5 top rim, r = 5 plus-1e-9 (ball 1e-9 mm wider than the post: no rolling-ball blend exists)
existence limit: post R=5 top rim, r = 5 plus-1e-12 (below any sensible tolerance: sphere cap or refusal)
existence limit: r = face width - 1e-9 (a 1e-9 mm sliver of each face stays)

regression.defect: D5 r = face width - 1e-9: 1e-9 mm sliver faces/edges below the 1e-6 modelling tolerance (strict STEP: edges 11 != 15)
regression.cause: brep.bend over.slide used the absolute eps 1e-9
regression.fix: over.slide, the strip, triangle and pair tests use the band tau = 1e-6 - 1e-9 mm: within tau the face is consumed (face-consumed)

near-tangent convex ridge, normal angle 0.00001 rad

regression.defect: D1 near-tangent ridge: ok result with the blend face inverted (sense false) in both variants
regression.cause: fit.bend ref_normal = unit(edge point - section mid); that vector is r(1/cos b - 1) ~ 2.5e-11 mm long, below the 1e-20 floor of unit(), so the fallback (1,0,0) set an arbitrary sense
regression.fix: brep.bend passes nref = n_A(p_A) + n_B(p_B), the support faces' outward normals at the springs of station 0 (exactly the chamfer normal, the fillet normal at the section mid); fit.bend compares the blend's natural normal with it
regression.expect: ok, blend normals agree with the supports (pass-approx, dV = closed form)

regression.defect: D6 spline STEP: harness no-op (11% volume error the geometry does not have); 34 of 39 spline exports failed strict CurveOnSurface
regression.cause: scripts/fillet/stepx.mjs wrote no pcurves: OpenCascade projected the edges onto the B-spline itself (other parametrisation, re-trimmed face); and the 4-span sections / difference v-tangents left up to 2e-5 mm between the spline boundary and the exact edges, above the 1e-7 edge tolerance OpenCascade derives on import
regression.fix: stepx.mjs writes isoline PCURVEs parametrised in the 3D curve parameter (Hermite nodes at the knots); fit.bend skins 8 Bezier spans per section and, on circular edges, uses the exact rotation derivative with the circular arm length (boundary within ~1e-8 mm)

regression.fix: arc_shape and section_row take the plane normal from the unit radii (and clear.bend the triangle normal from unit sides), so the floor depends on angles only
